summary: Corrected to PARTIAL. The main cost is gone. Proposal part 1 holds: every surface the finding named (overview with crown, PlanSidebar and GitActionsControl, SideChatPanel, ContextHandoffInspectionPanel, ComputerBetaPreview, ExpandedImageDialog, AgentControlApprovals, PullRequestThreadDialog, NewWorktreeDialog, LinkedWorktreeItemDialog) is a preloadableLazy surface gated by useLazyComponentReady. Part 2 holds in effect: only ChatThreadRouteView and DraftChatThreadRouteView import the ChatRightPanel chunk. Part 3 holds: lexical, markdown-stack and shiki-engine groups exist. In the dist built after HEAD, ChatRightPanel is 651,936 B (637 KiB raw, about 200 KiB gzip), down from 1,115 KiB. The lazy surfaces carry about 835 KiB raw outside the thread route's static closure (overview 240 KiB raw / 78 KiB gzip, LinkedWorktreeItemDialog graph 384 KiB / 120 KiB, NewWorktreeDialog 113 KiB, and others). The thread route closure beyond boot is now 2,140 KiB raw / 724.5 KiB gzip at zlib level 6. Four things are not done. (a) Part 4, the ChatRightPanel ≤600 KiB budget, does not exist, and the chunk is still 637 KiB. (b) The only bundle guard, the ChatThreadRouteView closure budget (880 KiB gzip, comment still says 813 KiB), leaves about 155 KiB gzip of headroom. The whole overview stack could go back into the static graph without CI failing. The source test only checks direct imports in ChatView.tsx and BranchToolbar.tsx. (c) The phone-tier modules that the original verifier listed as lazy candidates are still static: PhoneThreadAppBar, PhoneThreadDock, PhoneSessionPolicySheet, PhoneModelSheet, MobileSelectSheet and MessageActionsSheet, about 28 KiB minified. A few small conditional dialogs and bars (about 20 KiB minified) are also still static. (d) The fix has small defects of its own. LazyPhoneOverviewSheet saves nothing, because ChatThreadRouteView statically imports the same PhoneWorkSurface module. The sidebar keeps private preloadableLazy wrappers for both worktree dialogs, which contradicts lazyWorktreeDialogs' 'one module state per dialog' claim. The chat header's linked-item badges have no intent preload, so a first click waits on the 384 KiB-raw dialog graph before anything appears.

evidence.note: preloadableLazy wrappers for ChatOverviewPanel, SideChatPanel, ContextHandoffInspectionPanel, ComputerBetaPreview, ExpandedImageDialog, AgentControlApprovals, PhoneOverviewSheet and PullRequestThreadDialog (part 1).

useLazyComponentReady gates every surface and handles load errors with a retry toast. The overview is wanted on renderCrownRail || showPhoneOverviewSheet, so drafts and empty threads skip it. Wide desktop threads with messages still load it after the first frame, with no parallel preload from the route.

651,936 B raw, 203,607 B .gz (dist mtime 21:45, after the HEAD commit at 21:40, clean tree). Only ChatThreadRouteView-*.js and DraftChatThreadRouteView-*.js reference it. DiffPanel, ThreadTerminalDrawer and ThreadWorkspacePanel do not (part 2 holds in effect).

ChatThreadRouteView beyond the main closure: 2,139.9 KiB raw, 724.5 KiB gzip (level 6). Incremental cost of each lazy surface on top of that, raw/gzip: ChatOverviewPanel 240/78 KiB, LinkedWorktreeItemDialog 384/120 KiB, NewWorktreeDialog 113/36 KiB, AgentControlApprovals 35/11 KiB, SideChatPanel 22/9 KiB, ComputerBetaPreview 16 KiB, ContextHandoffInspectionPanel 14 KiB, ExpandedImageDialog 6 KiB, PullRequestThreadDialog 5 KiB, PhoneWorkSurface 0 (already static).
The lexical, markdown-stack and shiki-engine vendor groups (part 3). Only ComposerPromptEditor imports lexical, so the 201 KiB lexical chunk is legitimately on the composer path.

The only guard is the ChatThreadRouteView closure budget, maxGzipBytes 880 KiB, with a stale comment saying 813 KiB. Measured 724.5 KiB, which leaves about 155 KiB gzip of headroom: re-adding the whole overview stack (78 KiB) statically would still pass. There is no per-chunk raw budget (part 4 is missing), and forbiddenSources covers only the hosted runtime.
The source guard checks only direct value imports in ChatView.tsx and BranchToolbar.tsx, so a transitive static import from a child component would not be caught.

Statically imports PhoneWorkSurfaceSheet from shell/phone/PhoneWorkSurface, the same module LazyPhoneOverviewSheet imports dynamically (chatViewLazySurfaces.ts:51-53). The dist confirms the static import (ChatThreadRouteView-DDyBEGY8.js imports PhoneWorkSurface-DalEivEW.js), so the lazy wrapper saves 0 bytes and only adds a gate.

Static imports of frozen phone-tier surfaces (PhoneThreadAppBar, PhoneThreadDock, PhoneSessionPolicyControl, PhoneModelSheet with MobileSelectSheet, MessageActionsSheet). Minified estimate: about 28 KiB raw, loaded on every desktop thread.

Other conditional surfaces still static: TranscriptSelectionActions (about 7 KiB minified), ThreadMessageSearchBar (about 4 KiB), DraftDeviceProjectDialog (about 3 KiB), ProjectScriptDialog (about 9 KiB).

The header's WorktreeSourceControlBadges gets onOpenLinkedItem but no onOpenLinkedItemIntent. A first click on a PR, issue or Jira badge loads LinkedWorktreeItemDialog plus WorkItemDetail plus markdown-stack (384 KiB raw / 120 KiB gzip) before the gated dialog mounts, with nothing shown meanwhile. Before the fix this dialog was in the static graph.

Private preloadableLazy wrappers for LinkedWorktreeItemDialog and NewWorktreeDialog duplicate worktrees/lazyWorktreeDialogs.ts:15-21, whose comment claims one module state per dialog for the chat and the sidebar. A sidebar preload does not flip the chat wrapper's isLoaded(), so the chat still waits an extra effect and commit. This is duplicated logic (AGENTS.md maintainability).

remaining: 1) Part 4 is missing: there is no budget for the chat chunk, and ChatRightPanel is 637 KiB raw against the ≤600 KiB target. The existing ChatThreadRouteView closure budget (scripts/perf/model.ts:286-289, 880 KiB gzip) is about 155 KiB above the measured 724.5 KiB, so it would not catch the overview or other deferred surfaces returning to the static graph. 2) The frozen phone tier is still statically in the chat graph: ChatView.tsx:239 PhoneThreadAppBar, ChatComposer.tsx:124 PhoneThreadDock, ComposerFooter.tsx:27 PhoneSessionPolicyControl, ProviderModelPicker.tsx:18 PhoneModelSheet/MobileSelectSheet, MessagesTimeline.tsx:115 MessageActionsSheet, ChatThreadRouteView.tsx:44 PhoneWorkSurfaceSheet. Together about 28-35 KiB raw on every desktop thread. 3) Small conditional surfaces are still static: ChatView.tsx:16 TranscriptSelectionActions, :230 ThreadMessageSearchBar, :381 DraftDeviceProjectDialog, ProjectScriptsControl.tsx:15 ProjectScriptDialog (about 20 KiB minified). Removing 2 and 3 would bring ChatRightPanel to roughly 580-590 KiB, under the 600 KiB target.
fixDefects: (a) LazyPhoneOverviewSheet (chatViewLazySurfaces.ts:51-53) is defeated: ChatThreadRouteView.tsx:44 statically imports the same PhoneWorkSurface module, so the split saves 0 bytes and only adds a gate before the first open. The bundle test only checks ChatView.tsx, so it does not notice. (b) The chat header's linked-item badges (ChatHeaderBar.tsx:58-75) have no onOpenLinkedItemIntent preload, unlike the sidebar. Because of the fix, a first click on a header PR, issue or Jira badge now waits on about 120 KiB gzip of chunks with no visual feedback. This is a small UX regression on slow or hosted links. (c) SidebarWorktreeList.tsx:253-259 and SidebarProjectDialogOwner.tsx:25-31 keep their own preloadableLazy wrappers instead of the shared lazyWorktreeDialogs exports, which contradicts that module's documented 'one module state per dialog' design. The effect on behaviour is negligible: one extra commit when the chunk is already cached. (d) Not a defect, but a trade-off to know about: on wide desktop threads that have messages, the overview (78 KiB gzip) now loads only after ChatView mounts. Nothing preloads it in parallel with the route chunk, so on a cold cache the crown appears one request round later than before (its slot width is reserved, so there is no layout shift).
implementationSketch: 1) Guard (S): in scripts/perf/model.ts, lower the ChatThreadRouteView maxGzipBytes to about 760 KiB and update the comment with the 2026-10-14 figure (724.5 KiB). Add forbiddenSources to that closure so the deferred surfaces cannot come back transitively. CI builds with RYCO_WEB_SOURCEMAP=hidden, so module attribution works. Patterns: ^apps/web/src/components/(chat/ChatOverviewPanel\.tsx|PlanSidebar|GitActionsControl|overview/crown/CrownOverview|SideChatPanel|chat/ContextHandoffInspectionPanel|chat/ComputerBetaPreview|chat/ExpandedImageDialog|PullRequestThreadDialog|worktrees/(NewWorktreeDialog|LinkedWorktreeItemDialog)|agent-control/AgentControlApprovals|workItems?/WorkItemDetail), plus ^node_modules/parse5/. This is a stronger guard than a per-chunk ≤600 KiB raw rule, because the chunk name 'ChatRightPanel' is just rolldown's naming of the shared chat chunk and is not stable. Optionally also add per-chunk maxRawBytes support to scripts/perf/bundleBudget.ts. Extend scripts/perf/bundleBudget.test.ts with a fixture for the new rule. 2) Phone tier (S-M): add preloadableLazy wrappers (next to chatViewLazySurfaces, or a shell/phone/lazyPhoneSurfaces.ts) for PhoneThreadAppBar, PhoneThreadDock, PhoneSessionPolicyControl, PhoneModelSheet and MessageActionsSheet. Mount them only when useLazyComponentReady(component, presentationTier === 'phone') is true, and preload when the tier is phone. Make ChatThreadRouteView use a lazy PhoneWorkSurfaceSheet the same way, which also makes LazyPhoneOverviewSheet effective; otherwise delete LazyPhoneOverviewSheet. This only lazy-loads frozen-tier code and does not extend or delete it (AGENTS.md). Add the specifiers to chatViewBundleSplitting.test.ts for ChatView.tsx, ChatComposer.tsx, ComposerFooter.tsx, ProviderModelPicker.tsx, MessagesTimeline.tsx and ChatThreadRouteView.tsx. 3) Make TranscriptSelectionActions (mount when a selection exists), ThreadMessageSearchBar (when search is open), DraftDeviceProjectDialog and ProjectScriptDialog (open state) lazy in the same way, with notifyChatSurfaceLoadFailure for errors. 4) Fix defects: pass onOpenLinkedItemIntent={() => void LazyLinkedWorktreeItemDialog.preload()} from ChatHeader through ChatHeaderBar to WorktreeSourceControlBadges. Replace the private wrappers in SidebarWorktreeList.tsx and SidebarProjectDialogOwner.tsx with LazyLinkedWorktreeItemDialog and LazyNewWorktreeDialog from worktrees/lazyWorktreeDialogs. Add a test that only lazyWorktreeDialogs.ts contains import('…/LinkedWorktreeItemDialog') and import('…/NewWorktreeDialog'). 5) Optional: in the thread route loader (non-preload navigations) or at ChatThreadRouteView module scope, call LazyChatOverviewPanel.preload() when the overview opens by default (wide, non-phone, server thread), so the crown chunk loads in parallel with the route instead of after mount. Verify by building with RYCO_WEB_SOURCEMAP=hidden and running `bun run perf:bundle-budget`, the vitest chatViewBundleSplitting and preloadableLazy tests, and the apps/web browser test perf/LazyComponentReady.browser.tsx. Then compare the ChatRightPanel size; expect about 590 KiB or less.
decisionReason: None of this touches auth, E2EE, hosted lifecycle or the Hub. Lazy-loading frozen web phone-tier components neither extends nor deletes that tier, so it stays within the AGENTS.md rules. The optional overview preload is a small UX timing choice that needs no product sign-off.
